name: fincloud-sentinel
description: A cloud-native fintech transaction assurance and AI operations reference solution.
author: Gray Xu <thunderxu7@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w services/core-api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w services/core-api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/domain && npm run typecheck -w services/core-api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/domain && npm run test -w services/core-api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.eval: uv run --project services/ai-copilot --extra dev python services/ai-copilot/evaluate.py
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:python && npm run eval && npm run docs:check && npm run guides:check && npm run api:lint && npm run build
